Analyzing and developing .Net 3.0 -4.5 code, C#, SQL and T-SQL   85%  
 - Unit test, documentation, code review     15%  

 

  Must have expert skill analyzing and writing .NET code using C#.  Expert skill using and applying advanced MVC, Web Forms, Entity Framework, MS Enterprise Libraries and WCF - At least 5 years - Intermediate skill analyzing and writing complex SQL statements using multi table joins, exist clauses, etc. is a plus  

 - Microsoft SQL Server 2008 R2 - At least 5 years - Must have ability to analyze, modify and create advanced SQL statements and queries using T-SQL  

 - Microsoft Visual Studio 2012/2013, TFS - At least 5 years  

 - Microsoft office products to create design and technical documentation.  

 - Development Using Agile and SDLC Teams.  

 - Developer Unit Test - At least 5 years - Must have Ability to perform comprehensive unit tests, creating test cases, acceptance criteria and scripts to provide secure and accurate code.   

 - Developer Code Review - At least 5 years - Must have Ability to defend code and logic in a formal code review   

 - Experience with Agile Software Development is a plus  

 - Experience with Telerik UI controls is a plus
